new_scholarship.description: The A*STAR International Fellowship funds Singaporean or Singapore Permanent Resident early-career researchers for up to two years of overseas postdoctoral training at leading overseas universities, research institutions or deep-tech startups that are portfolio companies of top-tier venture capital or builder firms. It is offered in two tracks: AIF (Research), a research-focused postdoctoral track, and AIF (Innovation), which places fellows in deep-tech startups and venture-capital environments. Applicants must have completed a PhD within the last four years and must not hold existing institutional bonds. Recipients receive a monthly overseas living allowance, a monthly sustenance allowance inclusive of CPF contribution, annual return airfare and several other allowances.

alerts.message: Temasek states the Academic Year 2026/2027 window 'has been extended until 15 September 2026'. That date has passed, so applications are not currently being accepted and Temasek has published no next-cycle date. The page's 'now open' wording is out of date.
